Dragon Majesty

Released September 7, 2018 · 80 cards

Expanded

Dragon Majesty is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on September 7, 2018. Its main set has 70 cards, plus 10 secret rares numbered beyond the set (80 in total). It includes 67 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

42 illustrators worked on Dragon Majesty. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (12), Ken Sugimori (7), Kouki Saitou (4), Mitsuhiro Arita (3), PLANETA Igarashi (3), Shin Nagasawa (3), Yoshinobu Saito (3), Eske Yoshinob (2).
